mechanism_narrative: Sustained drop in TRANSIT and WORKPLACES indicates commuter and workplace activity suppression, which removes daytime footfall from retail/recreation districts, driving RETAIL_REC lower over the next 4 weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT fell from 4.9 to -35.6 and WORKPLACES from 3.1 to -26.4 between t-3w and t-0w
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is higher than over the last 28 days despite TRANSIT and WORKPLACES remaining below -20.

mechanism_narrative: When RETAIL_REC itself falls more than 20 points week-on-week, it signals a regime shift where retail and recreation establishments face demand collapse and closures, causing further declines over the next 2 weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:RETAIL_REC dropped from -3.0 at t-1w to -39.1 at t-0w
failure_condition: After a week-on-week RETAIL_REC drop exceeding 20 points, the next 14-day mean RETAIL_REC is equal to or higher than the prior 14-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: When RESIDENTIAL mobility rises while PARKS mobility falls, it indicates a shift from outdoor leisure to staying home, which reduces trips to retail/recreation venues and predicts lower RETAIL_REC over the next 2 weeks.

failure_condition: When RESIDENTIAL is above 5 and PARKS is below 0, RETAIL_REC over the next 14 days is not lower than over the previous 14 days.

failure_condition: With WORKPLACES below -20, the next 28-day mean RETAIL_REC is higher than or equal to the prior 28-day mean.
